chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:

Whoever has the means by which he may perform hajj, then continues to delay that, while he has no occupation concerning it for which Allah would excuse him, until death comes, has indeed neglected one of the ordinances of Islam.

key_terms.شَرَائِعِ الْإِسْلَامِ: the ordinances and prescribed laws of Islam
key_terms.يَعْذِرُهُ: excuses him or accepts his excuse

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about delaying hajj when a person has the means to perform it?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against delaying hajj when one already possesses the means and has no valid excuse before Allah. It presents such neglect as the abandonment of one of the ordinances of Islam, showing the gravity of postponing an obligatory act of worship without justification.
